documents.title: Refund Window Policy
documents.text: A refund is approved only when requested within 30 days of delivery, and the item is unused with original packaging. Requests after day 30 require manager approval.

documents.title: Refund Escalation Procedure
documents.text: When a refund request arrives after the 30-day window, the Worker must not approve it directly. It routes a summary to a named store manager.

documents.title: About This KSoR
documents.text: This KSoR governs refund policy for a small online store.
